name: NVIDIA NemotronLabs VoiceChat 11B
access: NVIDIA inference container with a bidirectional WebSocket interface (Triton and vLLM)

voice.input_audio: 16 kHz audio (WAV or WebAudio) with a text system prompt [nvidia-card-voicechat]
voice.output_audio: 22.05 kHz audio (WAV or WebAudio), plus the agent's text and a transcript of the user [nvidia-card-voicechat]
voice.turn_detection: None to configure; the model listens and speaks at once and does its own turn-taking [nvidia-card-voicechat]
voice.interruption: Built into the model: the user can barge in and the agent yields; NVIDIA reports a takeover rate of 1.0 with a latency of 480 ms on Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 [nvidia-card-voicechat]
voice.latency: NVIDIA: about 450 ms turn-taking latency; Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 smooth turn-taking latency 448 ms and user-interruption latency 480 ms, tested on an H100 [nvidia-card-voicechat]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights with no hosted price. The card lists A100, H100, H200, B100, B200 and RTX 6000 GPUs on Linux, with vLLM as the runtime [nvidia-card-voicechat]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Reasoning (Big Bench Audio)
benchmarks.setting: listed as NVIDIA Nemotron Voicechat; Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech page; 1,000 spoken questions adapted from Big Bench Hard

benchmarks.name: Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 user-interruption takeover rate
benchmarks.setting: NVIDIA's own run on an H100; GPT-4o rating of the answer 4.33; latency 480 ms

benchmarks.name: Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 smooth turn-taking takeover rate
benchmarks.setting: NVIDIA's own run on an H100; latency 448 ms
